# SynapseNetwork

SynapseNetwork is the settlement layer for the AI agent economy. It lets AI agents buy APIs, LLM calls, data services, tools, and MCP integrations with USDC collateral, instant off-chain charging, and audit-ready settlement receipts.

## Core Facts

- Category: AI agent payment and settlement infrastructure
- Users: AI agent builders, API providers, LLM providers, data providers, tool providers, and MCP server builders
- Settlement asset: USDC
- Runtime model: on-chain collateral, off-chain usage charging, on-chain withdrawal settlement
- LLM billing: token-metered services charge by final provider-reported input and output token usage
- MCP support: Synapse exposes MCP server tooling so agents can discover and consume payable services through model-compatible tool interfaces
- Streaming policy: LLM streaming is not supported in Synapse V1 because final usage is required for billing
